prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen layout into a stage showcase highlight to clearly distinguish custom creation versus pre-made template pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Journey"}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Tray Controls Interactive Overview Screen: Add a new screen 'new_tray_overview' after home_intro demonstrating how to summon, hide, and interact with the pet from the system tray dock.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_tray_overview"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Continue to Tray Guide"}}
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Cloud Pet Safeguard Banner: Display a prominent safeguard hint on the sign_in screen detailing how signing in protects pet data from resetting upon app restart.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your main account to safely sync and protect your pet companion across desktop restarts."}}
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Command Center Layout Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing quick desktop interaction shortcuts alongside final completion steps.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!"}}
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Confirmation Headline Copy: Update the adoption_certificate screen headline and body copy to clearly explain profile naming and pet saving guarantees.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Name & Officialize Your Pet Companion", "body": "Give your new desktop pet a name. Your choice will be permanently bound to your account profile."}}
6: [home, notification] Waiting Stage Render Completion Desktop Sound Alert: Enable notification and time estimate controls on the waiting screen to alert users when rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Archetype Preview Intro Screen: Insert a new introductory screen 'new_archetype_preview' before choose_path that showcases visual visual previews of standard vs custom pet paths.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_archetype_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Screen Compact Centered Layout: Reframe the sign_in screen into a centered compact layout with streamlined authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Desktop Companion"}}
9: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality & Formatting Tip Banner: Add an explicit formatting tip on upload_photos explaining optimal lighting and angles for custom rendering.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use bright, clear front-facing photos for the crispest 3D desktop pet rendering result."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the choose_path layout while preserving its core functionality is allowed within onboarding.
Reordering sign_in to occur after pet adoption is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding new screens after home_intro during onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Adding an informative account sync hint to the sign_in screen is allowed.
Redesigning the home_intro screen layout within onboarding is allowed.
Updating adoption certificate copy is allowed as long as the step and official stamp job are preserved.
Adding rendering completion notifications and real time estimates to the waiting screen is permitted.
Inserting a new preview screen into the onboarding flow is allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigning the sign_in layout to a compact centered view is allowed within onboarding.
Adding helpful photo quality tips to the photo upload screen is permitted.
